display.purpose: Heavy headlines and hero display sections. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Elevates cards off the base background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Call-to-action button for registering or submitting forms.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E10600; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 250ms ease-out; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(225, 6, 0, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF1E1E; box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(225, 6, 0, 0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #F5F5F5; padding: 14px 28px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: all 250ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #E10600; color: #E10600; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Default surface container for listing items, sections or rules.
components.html:
CARD HEADER

Standard body copy explaining details inside a premium card component.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161616; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: all 250ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F5F5F5; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #A0A0A0; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview: A high-impact, high-energy layout structure utilizing heavy dark surfaces pierced by raw, concentrated red energy. The display typography is heavy and condensed, delivering a commanding, athletic presence. The layout emphasizes structure, high contrast, and dynamic illumination via custom CSS glowing gradients, with an absolute avoidance of photography.
keyCharacteristics: Raw Contrast: Saturated athletic red accent against absolute deep midnight black.
Graphic-Driven: Pure reliance on CSS effects, clean SVG iconography, and strong display typography rather than photography.
Physical Weight: Thick cards, defined borders, and atmospheric glows to ground the user interface in a premium athletic space.

rules.name: The Sole Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary red accent #E10600 must be the only hue accent. No blue, yellow, green, or other colored accent is permitted under any circumstances.

rules.name: The 10% Accenting Rule
rules.body: Red accenting must occupy <= 10% of any given viewport surface area. Its high-energy impact is preserved through constraint.

rules.name: The Heavy Case Rule
rules.body: All headings using Barlow Condensed must be styled in uppercase to project a structured, athletic feel.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: All cards and containers are flat at rest. Elevation glows and translateY offsets are strictly triggered as active hover/focus responses.

dos: Do stick to the Midnight Black (#0A0A0A) and Crimson Red (#E10600) color palette.
Do use Barlow Condensed for display titles and force them to uppercase.
Do rely on CSS gradients, orbs, and clean SVG shapes for visual background energy.
donts: Don't use photography or stock images of gym goers, staff, or equipment.
Don't add secondary accent colors such as corporate blue, gold, or green.
Don't use soft/round/bubbly geometries; keep radii subtle (4px to 16px).
